in_sanskrit.name: धनिराम
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Dhaniram is derived from two Sanskrit words: 'धन' (dhan) meaning 'wealth' and 'राम' (rama) meaning 'pleasing, delightful'. So, Dhaniram can be translated as 'one who is pleasing and prosperous with wealth'.

in_hindi.name: धनीराम
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Dhaniram in Hindi is derived from the words 'धनी' (dhanī) which means 'wealthy' and 'राम' (rām) which means 'pleasing, delightful'. So, Dhaniram can be translated as 'one who is pleasing and prosperous with wealth'.

in_tamil.name: தன்னிராம
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Dhaniram in Tamil is derived from the words 'தன்னு' (tañṉṉu) which means 'self' and 'இராமம்' (irāmam) which refers to Rama, a popular Hindu deity. So, Dhaniram can be translated as 'one who has Rama within oneself' or 'one who is self-reliant and has Rama as a guiding deity'.

in_telugu.name: ధనిరామ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Dhaniram in Telugu is derived from the words 'ధని' (dhanī) which means 'wealth' and 'రాము' (rāmū) which refers to Rama, a popular Hindu deity. So, Dhaniram can be translated as 'one who has Rama and wealth' or 'one who is prosperous with Rama as a guiding deity'.

in_marathi.name: Dhaniram
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of wealth and power
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhaniram हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhan means wealth and Ram means God. The name Dhaniram signifies the God of wealth and power. It is a name of reverence, respect and awe. It is a name that inspires faith, trust and devotion. It is a name that signifies prosperity, strength and loyalty.
